incident: api-app 0.2.11-17 RELEASE channel shipped a stale versionCode-16 binary
class: wrong-binary distribute (§6.Z) — stale build output, distinct from the 1.3.11-1068 picker bug

what_shipped.intended: 0.2.11 (17) with the ApiEngineService FGS non-fatal telemetry
what_shipped.actual: 0.2.11 (16) — versionCode 16, sha 019eb1812ecc..., byte-identical to the prior 16 release; NO FGS telemetry
what_shipped.impact: LOW — only the FGS-budget-exhaustion diagnostic non-fatal is absent on the api-app release channel; client debug+release + api-app debug shipped correctly with the full telemetry

root_cause: the first 1.3.11-1071 Android rebuild FAILED at :app:uploadCrashlyticsMappingFileRelease (transient UnknownHostException to firebasecrashlyticssymbols.googleapis.com) BEFORE :api-app:assembleRelease finished packaging. :api-app:clean was NOT in the rebuild, so the release output stayed at the 1070-cycle's versionCode-16 APK. The subsequent type-fix rebuild was :app-only, so the stale api-app release output was never refreshed. It was staged as lava-api-app-0.2.11-17-release.apk (filename 17) but its manifest said 16.
why_gates_missed_it: firebase-distribute.sh _pick_apk_by_version matches the FILENAME (*-17-release.apk), not the APK's actual manifest versionCode. §6.P checks build.gradle's versionCode (17) > last-distributed (16) — also filename/config level, not the bytes. So a correctly-NAMED but stale-CONTENT APK passed every gate.
detection: post-distribute anti-bluff verification: aapt2 dump badging on each distributed binary revealed api-app-17-release.apk versionCode='16'.

remediation.mechanical: firebase-distribute.sh now has a §6.Z content-versionCode guard (_assert_apk_versioncode) that aapt2-dumps the picked APK and FATALs if its actual versionCode != APP_VERSION_CODE. This catches the stale-content class the filename picker cannot.
remediation.corrective_ship: api-app bumped to 0.2.11-18, CLEAN-rebuilt (:api-app:clean), aapt-verified versionCode 18, re-distributed (debug+release) — supersedes the wrong 17 release. Shipped alongside client 1.3.11-1072 (the H1 search fix).
remediation.process: clean rebuilds (:module:clean) for distribute artifacts + aapt-verify EVERY staged APK's actual versionCode before distribute (no longer filename-trust).

honest_note: found by the conductor's own post-distribute verification, not by a user report — the anti-bluff aapt sweep is exactly why this surfaced in minutes instead of as a field complaint.
